author: Kuhn & Rueß GmbH
name: Event Driven Ansible
description: Send rule based events to Event Driven Ansible

account_custom_field_help.auth_header: HTTP header the token is sent in (default Authorization). Only used when the account has a password but no username: the password is the token. With a username, the request uses Basic Auth instead.
account_custom_field_help.auth_prefix: Text put in front of the token, separated by a space (default Bearer, what the ansible.eda.webhook source expects). Leave it empty when the event stream wants the bare token in the header.
